description: Kisspeptin-10 (Kp-10) is the C-terminal decapeptide of the KISS1 precursor and the shortest kisspeptin fragment that retains full agonist activity at the KISS1 receptor (GPR54). It is the standard tool peptide in neuroendocrine research on the hypothalamic regulation of gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) neurons.

faq.question: What is Kisspeptin-10?
faq.answer: Kisspeptin-10 is the ten-amino-acid C-terminal fragment of the KISS1 precursor (CAS 374675-21-5) and the standard KISS1R/GPR54 agonist used in neuroendocrine research.

faq.question: Why use the 10-residue fragment rather than full-length kisspeptin?
faq.answer: Because the decapeptide retains full receptor potency, so it is the practical research-grade fragment for receptor and GnRH-neuron studies.
